triggers.name: trg_sync_listing_from_tenancy
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_listing_from_tenancy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'active' then
    update public.listings
    set status = 'rented',
        updated_at = now()
    where id = new.listing_id;
  elsif new.status in ('ended', 'cancelled') and old.status = 'active' then
    update public.listings
    set status = 'archived',
        archived_at = now(),
        updated_at = now()
    where id = new.listing_id;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_listing_from_tenancy AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tenancies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_listing_from_tenancy()
